name: compress
description: Compress a large file or piped text into a distillate before reading it in full
---
<!-- generated by tools/build-codex-plugin.js from plugin/; edit the source there, not this file -->

> Host: Codex CLI, through the `agenticos` plugin. Invoke as `$agenticos:compress`. `<plugin root>` is the plugin's folder, two levels above the folder that holds this SKILL.md; the `aos` launcher is `<plugin root>/bin/aos`. The tools of the `agenticos` MCP server are named `mcp__agenticos__<tool>`.

Compress the input:

1. Bash: `aos compress the text the user wrote after `$agenticos:compress`` (fallback: `sh "<plugin root>/bin/aos" compress the text the user wrote after `$agenticos:compress``). Without `--local` it prints a `<<<AOS_CONTEXT feature=compress>>> … <<<END>>>` block with the chunked input and the requested style, word cap and focus. Write the distillate yourself in that style and print it.
2. With `--local` the provider produces the distillate; relay it verbatim.
3. If the script errors, read the file directly and summarize it yourself.
